entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Diana, I need to return this helmet I bought. This whole process is a joke and I'm not happy.

I'm very sorry to hear about your frustration, sir. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference! The color is hideous, nothing like the pictures. I'm not putting this on my head. The box is unopened, sitting right here. I just want my money back. Now.
I certainly understand wanting the product to be exactly as you expected. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. Could I please get your order number to pull up the details?
It's VF-8675309. Look, either process this return or get me a manager. I don't have time for this. I'll make sure everyone knows how you treat customers.
Thank you for that information. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see you purchased the Urban Commuter helmet, and it was delivered 19 days ago.
And? So what? Are you going to help me or are you going to waste more of my time?
I can absolutely help you, sir. I've just checked our policy and your purchase is well within the 90-day return window. I'm approving the return for you right now.
Wait, really? Just like that? You're giving me a full refund?

Yes, a full refund. I have just emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Simply attach it to the box and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay. Well, that's what you should have done in the first place. Fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
